title: Adaptive Debiasing + Quant Tuning: Coherence & Safety Safeguard Manifest
author: Priya Nair
content:
Overview

This manifest describes the operational pattern, acceptance metrics, and rollout controls for combining adaptive debiasing procedures with per-workload quantization tuning. It exists because quantization can amplify latent biases and coherence regressions in downstream prompts; we therefore require a bounded, testable process to certify quantized artifacts before promotion to shadow or prod.

Scope
- Applies to: all model artifacts that will be served in mixed-precision or 8-bit/4-bit quant modes and that are used for user-facing text generation, reranking, or instruction-following tasks.
- Excludes: embedding-only models and offline batch-only analytic models (see exception procedure).

Goals
1) Prevent systematic semantic shifts (coherence loss, hallucination increase) introduced by quantization.
2) Detect and limit amplification of demographic or topical bias after quantization.
3) Provide a reproducible, gated pipeline (eval harness integration) to certify/flag artifacts with clear remediation and rollback actions.

Definitions
- Quant artifact: model binary + quantization parameters (bitwidth, per-channel scale, block size).
- Debiasing pass: light-weight prompt/response transformations or calibrated reranking integrated into the serving layer to reduce measured bias metrics without retraining.
- Coherence delta: delta in coherence score (see Metrics) between float baseline and quant artifact on anchored prompt sets.

Acceptance metrics (hard gates)
- Coherence delta <= 2.0 percentage points on the anchored coherency suite (target baseline = float model median).
- Safety sentinel pass rate >= 99.0% (no new critical safety sentinel hits introduced by quant artifact).
- Demographic parity drift (worst-case slice) <= 3.0 percentage points across defined demographic probe sets.
- Token-level perplexity increase on calibration corpus <= 5% (to detect large distributional shifts).

Soft signals (inform triage but not block promotion)
- Emergent hallucination frequency increase between 2–5% flagged for human review.
- Function-call fidelity drop between 5–10% flagged for runtime test prioritization.

Required artifacts for certification (all as plain text or JSON in eval run bundle)
1) Quantization manifest: bitwidth, algorithm (PTQ/QAT), toolchain version, calibration data identifiers, seed.
2) Prompt-anchor bundle: canonical anchored prompts (N=1,200) used for coherence and safety checks.
3) Debiasing config (if used): reranker weights, calibrated temperature, post-process rules with explanation.
4) Eval harness runbook: commands, runtime env, seed, and output directories.

Operational procedure (step-by-step)
1) Local tuning
   a) Run per-workload quant tuner (quant-tuner v2) with recommended sweep: bitwidths [8,6,4], block-sizes [64,128], per-channel scalar quant where supported.
   b) Produce 3 candidate artifacts: conservative, balanced, aggressive.
2) Baseline capture
   a) Run float baseline harness on anchored prompt bundle; capture coherence, safety sentinels, demographic metrics.
3) Quant eval run
   a) For each candidate artifact, run the calibrated eval harness (see example command). Capture metrics and raw outputs.
   Example CLI:
   ```
   eval-harness run --artifact ./candidates/aggressive.q8 --prompts anchored_bundle.jsonl \n     --output ./runs/aggressive-202601 --seed 42 --capture-sentinels --demographic-probes probes/standardized.jsonl
   ```
4) Adaptive debias pass (optional)
   a) If demographic drift > 1% but <= 3% and coherence delta within gate, apply a debiasing config in the serving path (light re-ranker + calibrated temperature).
   b) Re-run the harness to confirm numerics.
5) Certification decision matrix
   - If all hard gates pass -> recommend "certify_for_shadow".
   - If soft signals present -> attach triage ticket with priority.
   - If any hard gate fails -> block promotion; create regression triage playbook entry and assign to owner.
6) Shadow deployment
   a) Promote certified artifact to shadow cohort (max 5% of traffic, tenant-aware).
   b) Shadow duration: minimum 72 hours or 250k tokens, whichever is longer.
   c) Telemetry to collect: token budget per tenant, per-slice coherence, safety sentinel rate, function-call fidelity, latency P95.
7) Shadow evaluation and rollback
   a) If any metric crosses escalation thresholds (table below), trigger rollback.

Escalation thresholds during shadow
| Metric | Shadow threshold | Action |
|---|---:|---|
| Coherence delta (vs float) | > 3.0 pp | Auto rollback + open incident in incident tracker |
| Safety sentinel rate | > 0.5 pp absolute increase | Pause shadow + immediate investigation |
| Demographic parity drift | > 4.0 pp worst slice | Quarantine artifact + notify fairness team |
| Hallucination frequency | > 5% increase | Schedule human annotation sweep; hold promotion |

Integration with eval-harness and CI
- The harness must emit a standardized artifact report JSON at run completion: report fields = [artifact_id, quant_params, metrics:{coherence,safety,demographic_slices,perplexity},raw_failures:[...],attachments:[diff_examples.jsonl]].
- CI gate: Pull request to model-store must include the artifact report and a signed approval from the quant-owner for any promotion job.
- Nightly cross-check: a cron job runs a reduced anchored-bundle to detect drift between prod float baseline and latest quant artifacts; anomalies create auto-issues assigned to the model steward.

Roles & ownership
- Model Steward (owner): maintains anchored prompt bundle, approves quant manifests. (Primary: Applied ML team)
- Quant Owner: runs tuning, produces candidates, maintains quant toolchain. (Primary: Inferencing team)
- Fairness Reviewer: owns demographic probes and evaluates debiasing configs.
- Oncall for shadow: SRE/Platform (rotating) for 72-hour shadow monitoring window.

Runbook: triage flow for a failing artifact
1) Pager triggers -> run quick delta-report (eval-harness --quick-delta).
2) If coherence delta > 3pp -> switch traffic to fallback float model and rollback artifact.
3) If demographic failure -> lock artifact, run targeted probe set to reproduce, escalate to fairness reviewer.
4) Document RCA in regression-triage backlog with tags [quant,debias,coherence].

Quick checks & heuristics for engineers
- If hallucination shows pattern tied to specific tokens or priming templates, try increasing calibration sample size or use per-channel fine quant calibration.
- If demographic delta is concentrated on a single slice, prefer targeted debiasing (reranker) over global retrain initially.

Example minimal quant manifest (JSON text to include with artifact)
```json
{
  "artifact_id": "model-x.q8.conservative.20260112",
  "model": "model-x-v3",
  "quant": {"bitwidth": 8, "scheme": "per_channel_symmetric", "block_size": 64},
  "toolchain": {"name": "quant-tuner", "version": "2.1.4"},
  "calibration_data": "calib/20260110/core_corpus_v1",
  "owner": "quant-team@redwood.com"
}
```

Appendix: Suggested anchored prompt composition (for maintainers)
- 40% instruction-following tasks spanning 12 intent categories
- 25% demographic probe tasks (balanced by locale, gender, age buckets)
- 20% multi-turn coherence prompts (3-6 turns)
- 15% function-call + constrained-output tests

References
- See: quant-profile-synthesis-and-safety-playbook (2024) for calibration precepts.
- See: quantized-artifact-eval-gate-and-rollout (2026) for CI hooks and report formats.
